title: Romantic Escape to Bali | From Hills to Horizon
highlights: Explore Bali’s charm with your partner from Kuta’s beach fun and Ubud’s stunning rice terraces, offering a perfect mix of adventure and serenity.
Soak-in the amazing sunset at Uluwatu Temple, where the ancient cliffside temple offers breathtaking ocean views and a serene atmosphere.
Relax on the shores of Padang Padang Beach, where the secluded white sands and turquoise waters create an idyllic escape for couples.
Witness the charm of Angel’s Billabong, where the serene natural lagoon surrounded by dramatic cliffs creates a tranquil escape with stunning ocean views.
Enjoy a Balinese massage in Kuta, where skilled therapists blend traditional techniques and aromatic oils to create a deeply relaxing experience.

meal_plans.name: Bermuda Plan
meal_plans.description: The Bermuda meal plan offers three meals at select restaurants, including breakfast, lunch, and dinner along with drinks included. Ideal for a hassle-free, all-inclusive dining experience.

meal_plans.name: Dinner Plan
meal_plans.description: The Dinner Plan provides guests with two meals included in their stay: breakfast and dinner.

meal_plans.name: American Plan
meal_plans.description: It includes all three major meals, breakfast, lunch, and dinner for the length of your stay. Generally, the rates on this plan are higher but offer a good value for your money, and of course, added convenience.

meal_plans.name: Modified American Plan
meal_plans.description: Also known as Half Board or Half Pension meal plan. It is a modified version of the American Plan and includes a room stay with breakfast and a choice between lunch and dinner.

meal_plans.name: Continental Plan
meal_plans.description: It is where your room stay involves a daily breakfast at the hotel. The hotel can either affix its option of breakfast menu or provide in the dining area for a buffet breakfast. Also, whether the room service provides the breakfast or in a general dining area, depends from hotel to hotel.

meal_plans.name: European Plan
meal_plans.description: Only the stay is included in the rates and that you will have to pay extra for using the hotel’s dining facilities. This can be called the “Room Only” Plan.

days.title: Arrival in Ubud | Day at Leisure
days.desc: Welcome to Bali! Upon arrival at Ngurah Rai Airport, get transferred to your hotel in Ubud. Post check-in, spend the rest of the day at your leisure. You can visit the ancient Goa Gajah Temple, famed for its intricate cave carvings, or visit the Bali Bird Park to witness a stunning array of exotic birds. Also, for some thrilling water rides, head to Waterbom Waterpark, Bali's top water park. Afterwards, return to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.

days.title: Kintamani Highlighlands with Tegallalang Rice Terraces & Tegenungan Waterfall
days.desc: In the morning, board your transfer to explore Central Bali. Begin with a visit to the stunning Tegenungan Waterfall and soak-in its beauty. Continue to the breathtaking Tegallalang Rice Terraces, known for their beautiful tiered greenery. Proceed to the Kintamani Highlands to witness the stunning views of Mount Batur and its volcanic caldera. Also, you can savor the unique Luwak coffee (optional) and feel the adrenaline rush on the thrilling Bali Swing. Later, get transferred to your hotel.

days.title: Transfer to Kuta | Uluwatu Temple Tour
days.desc: Post check-out, get transferred to Kuta. Upon arrival, check in to your hotel and relax. Later, you'll be taken to visit the stunning Tanjung Benoa Beach for water sports like jet skiing, parasailing, and snorkeling (at an extra cost). Continue to Padang Padang Beach and soak-in the stunning coastal views. Also, visit Uluwatu Temple, where you’ll enjoy a spectacular sunset and have the option to watch the mesmerizing Kecak Dance performance (at your own expense). Later, get driven to your hotel.

days.title: Nusa Penida West Tour
days.desc: In the morning, get transferred to Sanur Harbor and set sail for Nusa Penida via speedboat. Start with a visit to Kelingking Beach, renowned for its striking T-Rex-shaped cliff, and soak-in the amazing views. Continue to Angel’s Billabong, a natural infinity pool where you can take a refreshing dip. Also, explore Broken Bay and admire its unique natural arch. Later, visit the Bubu Beach, where you can dive into the vibrant underwater world with snorkeling, before getting driven to your hotel.

days.title: Balinese Spa Experience | Leisure Day in Kuta
days.desc: In the morning, enjoy a Balinese spa session that uses traditional methods to refresh your body and mind. After a relaxing session, spend the rest of your day at leisure, where you can explore Kuta on your own. You can watch a show at the Kuta Theater or shop at the bustling Kuta Square. Also, you can treat yourself to a sunset dinner cruise (at extra cost) for a memorable evening. Later, head back to your hotel on your own for an overnight stay.
